// Generated by SEMAPRAX Public Generic Consumer v1
// (semaprax.public-generic-consumer-metadata.v1).
// Compiler-generated deterministic output; do not edit.
//
// This reads public generic *metadata*. It is not a calling convention: it
// receives no SEMAPRAX value, allocates none, frees none, and instantiates no
// Wasm module. The companion `consumer.d.ts` shows the substituted field tree
// in TypeScript; it defines no layout, no ownership transfer, and no ABI.
const MAX_DEPTH = 64;
const MAX_NODES = 4096;
const MAX_FIELDS = 8;
const MAX_RECORDS = 8192;
const MAX_BYTES = 1048576;
const MAGIC = "spxpgcm1;";
const SCALARS = ["bytes", "usize", "bool", "char", "i64", "i32", "f32", "f64", "u8"];

export const EXPECTED = new Uint8Array([
__EXPECTED__
]);

// A decimal count, without a leading zero, terminated by `stop`.
function decimal(bytes, at, stop) {
  const start = at;
  let value = 0;
  while (at < bytes.length && bytes[at] >= 0x30 && bytes[at] <= 0x39) {
    value = value * 10 + (bytes[at] - 0x30);
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value)) {
      return null;
    }
    at += 1;
  }
  if (at === start || (at - start > 1 && bytes[start] === 0x30)) {
    return null;
  }
  if (bytes[at] !== stop) {
    return null;
  }
  return [value, at + 1];
}

function matches(bytes, at, text) {
  if (at + text.length > bytes.length) {
    return false;
  }
  for (let index = 0; index < text.length; index += 1) {
    if (bytes[at + index] !== text.charCodeAt(index)) {
      return false;
    }
  }
  return true;
}

// One canonical grammar term. Returns the offset after it, or null.
function term(bytes, at, depth, counter) {
  if (depth > MAX_DEPTH || at >= bytes.length) {
    return null;
  }
  counter.nodes += 1;
  if (counter.nodes > MAX_NODES) {
    return null;
  }
  if (bytes[at] === 0x40) {
    const head = decimal(bytes, at + 1, 0x3a);
    if (head === null) {
      return null;
    }
    const [identity, afterLength] = head;
    at = afterLength;
    if (identity > bytes.length - at) {
      return null;
    }
    for (let index = 0; index < identity; index += 1) {
      if (bytes[at + index] === 0) {
        return null;
      }
    }
    at += identity;
    if (bytes[at] !== 0x3c) {
      return null;
    }
    at += 1;
    if (bytes[at] === 0x3e) {
      return at + 1;
    }
    for (;;) {
      const next = term(bytes, at, depth + 1, counter);
      if (next === null) {
        return null;
      }
      at = next;
      if (bytes[at] === 0x2c) {
        at += 1;
        continue;
      }
      if (bytes[at] === 0x3e) {
        return at + 1;
      }
      return null;
    }
  }
  for (const scalar of SCALARS) {
    if (matches(bytes, at, scalar)) {
      return at + scalar.length;
    }
  }
  return null;
}

// `null` when the document is the expected one; otherwise a closed reason.
export function verify(bytes) {
  if (bytes.length > MAX_BYTES || !matches(bytes, 0, MAGIC)) {
    return "malformed";
  }
  let at = MAGIC.length;
  let records = 0;
  while (at < bytes.length) {
    if (bytes[at] !== 0x7c) {
      return "malformed";
    }
    const head = decimal(bytes, at + 1, 0x3b);
    if (head === null) {
      return "malformed";
    }
    const [count, afterCount] = head;
    if (count === 0 || count > MAX_FIELDS) {
      return "malformed";
    }
    at = afterCount;
    const starts = [];
    const widths = [];
    for (let index = 0; index < count; index += 1) {
      const framed = decimal(bytes, at, 0x3a);
      if (framed === null) {
        return "malformed";
      }
      const [width, afterWidth] = framed;
      at = afterWidth;
      if (width > bytes.length - at) {
        return "malformed";
      }
      for (let byte = 0; byte < width; byte += 1) {
        if (bytes[at + byte] === 0) {
          return "malformed";
        }
      }
      starts.push(at);
      widths.push(width);
      at += width;
      if (bytes[at] !== 0x3b) {
        return "malformed";
      }
      at += 1;
    }
    const field = (index) => bytes.subarray(starts[index], starts[index] + widths[index]);
    const isData = (index) => matches(bytes, starts[index], "data") && widths[index] === 4;
    let position = null;
    if (widths[0] === 1) {
      const kind = String.fromCharCode(bytes[starts[0]]);
      if (kind === "P" && count === 6 && isData(3)) {
        position = 5;
      } else if (kind === "R" && count === 4 && isData(2)) {
        position = 3;
      } else if (kind === "I" && count === 4) {
        position = 1;
      } else if (kind === "A" && count === 4) {
        position = 3;
      } else if (kind === "F" && count === 5) {
        position = 4;
      }
    }
    if (position !== null) {
      const selected = field(position);
      const counter = { nodes: 0 };
      if (term(selected, 0, 0, counter) !== selected.length) {
        return "term";
      }
    }
    records += 1;
    if (records > MAX_RECORDS) {
      return "malformed";
    }
  }
  if (records === 0) {
    return "malformed";
  }
  if (bytes.length !== EXPECTED.length) {
    return "mismatch";
  }
  for (let index = 0; index < bytes.length; index += 1) {
    if (bytes[index] !== EXPECTED[index]) {
      return "mismatch";
    }
  }
  return null;
}

const selected = process.argv.slice(2);
if (selected.length > 1) {
  process.stderr.write("usage: consumer [metadata-file]\n");
  process.exit(2);
}
let document = EXPECTED;
if (selected.length === 1) {
  const { readFileSync } = await import("node:fs");
  document = new Uint8Array(readFileSync(selected[0]));
}
const refusal = verify(document);
if (refusal !== null) {
  process.stdout.write(`refused:${refusal}\n`);
  process.exit(3);
}
process.stdout.write("ok\n");
